messages:
Marco (oncall): quick handoff — I'm off at 03:45 UTC. Leaving an ongoing mitigation for INC-2026-203 (embeddings queue spike / KV evictions). Summary: embeddings queue in eu-west has been flapping for ~90m, causing increased p99 and a handful of customer regen errors. We have partial fallbacks enabled to prim/sec routing. Current state: p50 ~80ms, p95 ~420ms, p99 ~1.9s (was 600ms baseline). ~2.1% of regen requests returned 5xx in the last 30m.

incident-bot: [INC-2026-203] 3 active alerts: embeddings-queue-length-high, kv-eviction-rate, primsec-routing-fallback. Pager count in last 30m: 4.

Marco (oncall): Mitigations in-progress:
- scaled embeddings pool (eu-west) from 4 -> 6 (manual warm nodes) at 4998766250.
- lowered batch_size from 32 -> 16 for affected model family (v2-small) via rollout flag.
- enabled prefix KV caching for common prompt hashes (TTL 5m) to reduce repeated KV misses.
- soft-rate-limit applied to free-tier customers: rate limit = 30r/s; communicated to infra-limits.

Priya: thanks — is prim/sec routing fallback currently causing increased latency or just errors?

Marco (oncall): primarily latency. Fallback increases load on prim nodes; some requests time out when they hit evicted KV state and need to rebuild. Errors come from timeouts during regen, not model failures.

Jenna: I'll take secondary for the next 3h. Confirming I can access the eu-west runbook and the admin pool toggles.

Marco (oncall): confirmed — Jenna is secondary. Monica will be tertiary but not in-region for APAC. Note: coverage gap between 05:00–07:00 UTC where we won't have a local APAC primsec on-call; see action item.

Carlos: quick note — deploy-bot shows a canary rollback for quant-opt earlier; might have affected memory footprint on prim nodes. deploy-bot: Rollback: canary/quant-opt @ 4998766000 -> reverted. No new deploys after rollback.

Priya: action items for next shift if things re-escalate:
1) If p99 > 2.5s for >10m, escalate to SE team and run the emergency scale (below).
2) If kv-eviction-rate stays >100/min after 30m, increase cache TTL to 10m and add one more warm node.
3) If customer error rate >3% for 15m, open a customer-impact ticket and notify CS.

Marco (oncall): emergency scale command (internal tool):
```
# run as infra-admin
ri infra embeddings scale --region eu-west --pool primsec --to 10
```
Alternative (k8s):
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment embeddings-eu-prim --replicas=10
```
If scaling, watch for warmup CPU spike; do it in +2 increments if noisy.

Jenna: I've verified runbook RUNBOOK-EMB-02 and linked grafana dashboards. Grafana link: <https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/embeddings/eu-west-queue?orgId=1>. Also adding my checkpoints to the runbook.

incident-bot: Note: scheduled job that prefetches common prompts is disabled for safemode since 4998766800 to avoid extra KV churn.

Carlos: I'm going to follow memory graphs for prim nodes — I'll post any anomalies. FYI I saw one prim node OOM at 4998765902 before rollback; could be related.

Monica: coverage gap note — APAC primsec is unmanned 05:00–07:00 UTC because of shift rotation. If we hit cross-region failovers then handoff will require extra attention; recommend proactively increasing eu-west capacity before 05:00 UTC if traffic forecast > +15%.

Priya: small checklist I want the next shift to run on takeover:
- confirm primary/secondary assignment in PagerDuty (Marco/Jenna).
- verify scaling automation is healthy: `ri infra autoscale status --region eu-west` (expect healthy).
- check the `embeddings-queue-length` graph for fast spikes (threshold 500).
- if toggling cache TTL or scale, notify #infra-changes and CS on high-impact customers.

Jenna: taking ownership of monitoring for the next 3h. I'll post an hourly short update here.

Marco (oncall): thanks team — leaving my keyboard and phone reachable for 20m if anything spikes. Key escalation contacts: SE oncall (Priya), Infra lead (Carlos), SRE manager (Monica).

Priya: acknowledged. I'll update the incident timeline and prepare message to CS if error rate crosses threshold.

Jenna: acknowledged. Starting first check now (4998766500).

Marco (oncall): handoff complete. TL;DR: Jenna secondary, mitigations applied (scale, batch reduction, caching), watch p99 and kv-evictions, APAC coverage gap 05–07 UTC, commands in thread. Good luck :thumbsup:
